title: C.W. Anderson tests Dreamer’s endurance
summary: C.W. Anderson challenges one of ECW’s defining veterans with focused, punishing offense. A singles defeat forces Dreamer into a final test of who will surrender first.

chapters.title: Anderson defeats Dreamer
chapters.context: The rising opponent earns a major victory over the promotion’s veteran standard-bearer.

chapters.title: Dreamer wins the I Quit rematch
chapters.context: The result supplies a decisive payoff on ECW’s final original pay-per-view.
